system.description: Each level teaches two symbols; (SL + 1) may be active at once. Inventory action + 2 IP creates one you know, then: apply it to yourself; apply it to an ally you can see; or perform a damageless free attack that copies it onto every enemy hit — each copy counting against the limit.
